parts:
Hi, All;

 

I am using 64bit version of R-2.10.1 in Mac.

While I was trying to do the AllelicCrosstalkCalibration I got the following:

 

cdf <- AffymetrixCdfFile$byChipType(“Mapping250K_Sty”)

print (cdf) … worked OK!

 

gi <- getGenomeInformation(cdf)

print (gi) … worked OK!

 

si <- getSnpInformation(cdf)

print (si) … worked OK!

 

csR <- AffymetrixCelSet$byName(“SetA”, cdf=cdf)

print (csR) … worked OK!

 

acc <- AllelicCrosstalkCalibration(csR, mode=”CRMAv2”)

print (acc) … worked OK!
